parentTip.vi: Xem một trận đấu cùng con: "Which team is winning? Who scored the goal?"

chat.ask: Have you ever won a race?
chat.no: That's okay! Running is fun anyway!

gaps.s: Our football ___ has got eleven players.
He kicked the ball into the ___!
The ___ of the race gets a gold medal.

text.title: The Big Match
lines: Last Saturday, Tom's school team played a football match against another school.
At half time, the other team was winning one–nil.
Then Tom kicked the ball into the goal, and it was one–one!
In the end, Tom's team won two–one, and everybody got a prize.

questions.q: Who scored the first goal for Tom's team?
